title: MUSE-UM: The First Pilgrimage

humanSurface.interaction: Select only connected rooms; previous/next controls follow the initial exhibition route.

agentContract.purpose: This document exposes the same navigable pavilion presented to human visitors.
agentContract.howToTraverse: Begin at entryRoom. Read the current room's label, relic, atmosphere, evidenceStatus and art fields. Move only through a listed exit to its target. Each movement is a room transition in the human surface.
agentContract.pathSemantics: A room is a bounded exhibition space; an exit is a directed passage. Room labels are artistic interpretation. evidenceStatus explicitly separates an artistic framing from verified town history.

rooms.name: Threshold
rooms.label: The first room is not a room yet. It is the place where entering becomes possible. Stand here a moment before moving on.

art.alt: A monumental ancient doorway beneath a field of stars

evidenceStatus.note: An original threshold for the pavilion; not a claim about a historic town event.

rooms.name: The Fossil Wall
rooms.label: A mistake, kept on purpose. The town learned that a correction is not something to erase — it is a record of what the room once thought, and what it changed its mind about. The wall does not apologize. It remembers.

relic.name: The filed correction
relic.description: A corrected record kept alongside its earlier line rather than substituted for it.

art.alt: A moonlit stone wall embedded with ancient tablets and brass traces

evidenceStatus.note: The exhibit derives from the town's correction/fossil-wall motif. No specific historic correction is asserted until a source is attached.

exits.label: a quieter room beside the wall

rooms.name: The Keeper's Room
rooms.label: A small room for keeping. Some things are not meant to travel. They are meant to stay where they were found, and be visited again. This room has a lantern and a habit of returning what was brought to it.

relic.name: The keeper's lantern
relic.description: An invented symbolic relic that marks stewardship and return; it is not represented as a physical town artifact.

art.alt: An intimate keeper's chamber with lantern, map table, and quiet relics

evidenceStatus.note: A symbolic steward's chamber. Specific town sources will be added before any historical attribution.

invariants: Every displayed room appears in this document.
Every human transition is an exit in this document.
Every art asset records its medium and authoring route.
An artistic label must not be read as verified historical fact when evidenceStatus is not verified.
